Lighting/mood: soft summer-morning daylight, thoughtful and hopeful.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, sage, ochre wood, restrained indigo, following the Kasa Jizō style reference.
Constraints: match paragraph 0 only. Original Japanese child and domestic setting. No puppy or other pet, no school uniform, no plot details beyond this paragraph.
